description:
T-016a: Complete the PipeWire capture path that T-016 intentionally deferred. T-016 established the portal negotiation, state machine, event plumbing, restore-token persistence, and CaptureSource trait. This ticket fills the remaining gaps so that start_stream() produces real frames on M1 hardware.

Scope (binding):
1. PipeWire stream creation — Replace the start_stream() bail with real pw_stream_connect using the portal fd stored in PwInner.pw_fd. Create the stream on a dedicated PW thread (pw_thread_main).
2. SPA format pod negotiation — Build format pods advertising NV12 first, then P010/XR24/AR24 as fallback. Accept whatever the compositor returns. Reject anything outside that set with format-renegotiation-failed via capture.sessionLost.
3. DMA-BUF / SHM buffer negotiation — Prefer DMA-BUF (linear modifier acceptable). Fall back to SHM if compositor rejects DMA-BUF. If neither works then capture.sessionLost with reason no-acceptable-buffer-type.
4. Frame callback loop — In process_block callback, extract buffer data into FramePayload (DmaBuf or Shm variant), wrap in FrameHandle with monotonic seq and PTS, send through bounded frame_channel. If channel is full (back-pressure), drop the frame and increment dropped_since_last counter.
5. Counting sink — Consume frames from FrameReceiver, count them, drop ReleaseToken to re-queue buffers. No encoder integration (T-017).
6. capture.sessionReady — Fire once and only once when PW stream state reaches Streaming. Set phase to Recording. Carry real CaptureFormat from the negotiated format pod.
7. capture.formatChanged — Fire on OnParamChanged mid-stream with updated format.
8. Diagnostics update — run_diagnostics_loop reports state active with real format, total_produced, dropped_since_last, real fps counters once sessionReady fires.
9. PW command handling — Wire _cmd_rx in the PW thread to handle Pause (set stream to paused), Resume (set stream to streaming), Quit (exit loop).

Preserve from T-016 (do not modify):
- Portal negotiation flow (run_portal_flow)
- Restore-token persistence and path-traversal rejection
- Portal session close on stop/failure/cancel/disconnect/shutdown
- Cancel-safe request_session_cancellable
- In-flight portal negotiation cannot install active_capture after client disconnect
- capture.streamPaused/streamResumed event emission
- capture.sessionLost emission and reason codes
- stop_session cleanup (pw_quit flag, portal_close_tx drop, phase reset)
- Pipelined RPC frame bounds in server.rs
- Socket parent 0700 enforcement
- Simulator behavior (--simulate path unchanged)

Out of scope (binding):
- No window/region capture modes
- No hidden/metadata cursor modes
- No encoder integration (frames terminate at counting sink)
- No segment buffer
- No HDR/10-bit consumer path
- No rolling buffer
- No export/remux
- No v2 UI changes
- No Windows WGC/named-pipe
- No v1.1.0 recorder changes

Acceptance criteria:
1. start_stream() returns Ok after PW stream reaches Streaming state on M1.
2. capture.sessionReady fires with real dimensions/format after stream is usable.
3. capture.diagnostics at 1 Hz reports real total_produced increasing at source rate.
4. Idle source produces no synthetic frames (N-003 9.2).
5. Frame channel back-pressure drops frames and counts them in diagnostics.
6. capture.stopSession tears down PW stream cleanly. No leaked PW connections.
7. DMA-BUF attempted before SHM; SHM fallback works.
8. --simulate flag still works unchanged.
9. All existing tests pass (cargo test -p cove-replay-engine).

Verification:
- cargo build -p cove-replay-engine
- cargo test -p cove-replay-engine
- npm run typecheck
- npm run build
- npm run validate
title: Complete PipeWire stream connection, frame delivery, and sessionReady
